project_type: Static HTML form - single-file fillable agreement document
build_system: None - single HTML file, no build required
test_framework: Manual - open in browser and verify
test_command: N/A - verify by opening HTML in browser
verification_instructions: Open the generated HTML file in a browser, verify all fields are fillable, verify print preview shows black and white with signature blanks
setup_instructions: No setup needed - just open the HTML file
environment_constraints: No network access for package installation. Must use only standard HTML/CSS/JavaScript. The logo.jpg has been extracted from the .docx file already.
key_patterns: The agreement is in Hindi (Devanagari script) with some English terms. It has 17 sections plus a PDC receipt section. Fillable fields include: customer name, Aadhaar number, address, mobile, loan amount, dates, consultancy fee amount, cheque details (number, bank, account holder, amount, date). Signature areas needed for: Ruralift representative, Customer, 2 Witnesses.
directory_structure: Single repository with one .docx file and extracted logo.jpg. Output will be a single HTML file in the same directory.
